I saved it: the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 20 November. I noted Ilse Varga as the source, with her #north-team message and the time she posted it.

Before saving, I checked the brain for anything that disagreed and found nothing. That check doesn't prove much, though. The brain's search is set to keywords only, it turned up nothing on the order form, and the Tamsin account folder in the share is empty. So I had nothing to compare the date against.

I replied to Ilse in her thread in #north-team to say it's saved. As she asked, I took no other action.
